notes.title: Network Update
notes.content:
We've reduced the amount of bandwidth required for multiplayer by only syncing the pick up and throw events.

This means that you can have more players in a game (4) but it also means differences in physics simulation will mean objects aren't guaranteed to be in the same position on all clients. In practice you probably wont notice.

You should also only use join host on a local network. Otherwise use the quick match option.

notes.title: Quick Match and Bowling Update
notes.content:
Pretty dull but necessary update this time.

We've added a quick match option. This will match you with a public game in your geographic region if one exists. If not then you'll host a public match and someone else might join. [strike]You'll have to back out manually if nothing happens due to ports not being forwarded for the moment. [/strike] The game will time out after 20 seconds if no connection is made. (Forward port 7777 on your routers)

We've also added a private host option for friends only.

On the bowling side we've made it so that the ball doesn't get knocked out of your hand so easily and the unwaxed portion of the alley has been made a bit less frictiony and the ball comes out of the ball return chute instead of appearing out of mid air.

We've also made it so that the toggle grip is disabled if you're already holding something to prevent accidental gripping.

[strike]Also we've recently discovered a network buffer issue which was preventing objects from syncing which we've temporarily fixed by setting everything to all costs messaging which isn't great for performance. We'll switch it back once we find out what's going on.[/strike] 

Should be working now.

notes.title: Big 'ol update
notes.content:
Big one this time.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/22269100/ca3d1f0c8eb24fcce0b12ab2f17f3814034a1cd8.jpg[/img]

First off there's a new game, the much anticipated bowling alley!

Another big addition is an entire outside section!
It's basically a fancy start menu with some nice ambience.

There's also a super cool internet radio player! Now you can play your own music if you're sick of the ambient audio. We'll add a jukebox model for it later.
Follow this link to find out how to use it:
http://steamcommunity.com/app/435490/discussions/0/352788917744853147/
Currently doesn't sync in multiplayer.

We've also added a new usability feature for people with dodgy room setups or spotty tracking in places. You can now rotate the world using the orientation compass! Press the top menu button to view the compass and release to set the new forward direction.


Other changes:
[*]Custom loading scene
[*]Added Rocketball backboard
[*]New soda can models
[*]Open and "drink" the soda cans
[*]New fonts and models for the gift shop
[*]New boxing model to prevent phantom gloves blocking paddles
[*]Experimental Touch support
[*]Outdoor view culled while inside to improve performance
[*]New twinkly stars skybox
[*]New placeholder multiplayer models
[*]Giftshop prices
[*]Various bug fixes
